clauses.title: Scope –  Requirements for polyethylene spherical
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements for polyethylene spherical floats suitable for float valves of nominal sizes of 15, 20, 25, 32, 40 and 50 mm. Note— Nominal size of the float is related with the nominal size of the float valve with which it is to be used

clauses.title: Material – High density
clauses.text: 2. Material - High density polyethylene (HDPE) used for the manufacture of floats shall conform to Designation PEBW A50 T 090 or PEBN A50 T090 of    IS 7328 : 1992+. The addition of not more than 10 percent of the manufacturer's own rework material resulting from the manufacture of floats conforming to this standard is permissible. No other reworked material shall be used.

clauses.title: Leakage and Water Absorption Test
clauses.text: 5.1 Leakage and Water Absorption Test  -  The increase in mass of the float shall not be more than 0.5 percent and shall show no leakage.

clauses.title: Deflection Test
clauses.text: 5.2 Deflection Test — The float shall not deflect by more than 7 mm.

clauses.title: Impact Test
clauses.text: 5.3 Impact Test — Floats when dropped from a height of 1500 mm on to a concrete floor at ambient temperature shall not develop any crack or damage.

clauses.title: Boss Test
clauses.text: 5.4 Boss Test — The boss and/or float shall not be visibly   distorted or  damaged. Note — For method of test, refer to Appendices Ato C of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS  9762 : 1994  Specification for polyethylene floats (spherical) for float valves (first revision)
